test_overview: The application server was accessible on port 8000 and technician login (tech.ava.po2@example.com) succeeded, showing the technician dashboard with RFPs, Vendors, and POs nav links. However, the entire RFP/Vendor/Purchase-Order frontend feature is not implemented: clicking the 'RFPs' nav link (Step 1's required action to create an RFP) threw a JavaScript page error 'renderRFPs is not defined' and rendered no RFP page — only the leftover login form remained. Source review confirmed renderRFPs, renderRFPDetail, renderVendors, renderPOs, renderPODetail, loadRFPs, loadVendors, loadPOs, loadRFPOwnerOptions, loadPOFilterOptions, loadRFPLinkedPOs are all called in static/app.js but never defined. There is no UI path to create an RFP, so Step 1 (a FATAL action) failed, halting the whole test plan. All subsequent steps were not executed and scored 0. Final score: 0/19.
